audio.blocker: Per-app routing cannot be applied on this machine: the supported Settings page accepts and persists the per-app output selection, but Windows never moves any session to it - measured for the game and for a control tone routed to 100027813, SHARP HDMI and the known-good Headphones endpoint. The target endpoint is enumerated ACTIVE yet never receives audio (peak stays 0). Synthetic policy entries are ignored and the undocumented routing factory remains excluded, so routing stays unproven and the manual click-path is documented for a machine where the override is honoured.

routingAttempts.route: Settings page driven by UI Automation
routingAttempts.evidence: The game session stayed on Voicemeeter AUX (peak 0.029694) with the target at 0. A control SoundPlayer tone could not be moved to Headphones (3- E7 Stereo) or SHARP HDMI either, including from processes started after the setting was stored.
routingAttempts.conclusion: The per-app override is stored by the page but not applied by the audio stack on this machine. Routing to 100027813 is not achievable through this route.
